Title: Diagnosis
Details:
The bug report indicates that the class org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.ToStringStyle uses a ThreadLocal (named REGISTRY) which is created but never removed, causing a potential memory leak in web container or similar environments when the web app is reloaded.

Investigating the code snippets:
- The REGISTRY field is a private static final ThreadLocal<WeakHashMap<Object,Object>>.
- The getRegistry() method returns the ThreadLocal map or an empty map if the ThreadLocal has no value set.
- The constructor ToStringStyle() is empty and does not clean up the REGISTRY ThreadLocal.
- There is no found method named clearRegistry or anything similar to remove the thread local value after usage.

The failing test `testReflectionHierarchy()` of ToStringBuilderTest indirectly uses ToStringStyle (the test fixture uses reflection based ToStringBuilder) which likely triggers the initialization and usage of this ThreadLocal.

The fundamental issue is that the Round-robin or repeated usage of the ToStringBuilder and ToStringStyle classes keeps ThreadLocal values set per thread, which are never removed or cleared once done. This can cause a memory leak because the ThreadLocal's values keep references to objects in the webapp context, inhibiting garbage collection on web app reload/redeploy in container environments.

No code is found that removes or clears the ThreadLocal's value after completing the toString computation, which supports the bug report's description.

In summary:
- REGISTRY ThreadLocal in ToStringStyle is never cleaned
- This causes memory leaks in container environments as described
- The failing test triggers the bug given it uses reflection to build string representation, likely setting entries in REGISTRY

The bug should be fixed by providing a method that clears the ThreadLocal REGISTRY after use and properly using it in the relevant ToStringBuilder methods. Recent bug reports do not seem to be relevant to ThreadLocal or memory leaks so they can be ignored.

Hence, the root cause is the absence of cleanup code for the ThreadLocal REGISTRY in ToStringStyle when callers are done using ToStringBuilder/ToStringStyle.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
